name: codegen
description: Pinned codegen toolchain. Versions are exact on purpose: the CI drift check compares generated output byte-for-byte, so a floating dependency would produce spurious failures. NOTE: since 2.8 json-schema-to-zod emits the two-argument z.record(key, value), valid in both Zod 3 and Zod 4. The frontend stays on zod@^3 until a Zod 4 migration (its other API changes) is done and tested.
